offline_default.note: q4_k_m 3B is roughly 2.0-2.2GB resident on an 8GB Android device, leaving room for the app + OS. If a device is tighter on RAM, drop n_ctx to 2048 first before switching to a smaller model -- context length costs more RAM growth than the base weights once chat history builds up.

combined_call.description: generate_combined() asks the chat model for {response, memory} in a single call instead of a separate reply call + fact-extraction call. This is the primary latency/token reduction for the offline 3B model.
